errors.evidence: The description states there are five banks, but the chart legend and plot clearly show six distinct banks: Райфайзен банк, Алианц Банк България, Ти Би Ай Банк, ПроКредит Банк, БАКБ, and Токуда.

errors.text_span: На графиката са представени пет линии
errors.evidence: The description states there are five lines, but there are six lines plotted on the chart, corresponding to the six banks in the legend.
The description identifies the color of the line for 'Алианц Банк България' as brown ('кафява'), but it is clearly orange in the figure.
The description of the color for 'Ти Би Ай Банк' as 'сиво-сиво' is grammatically awkward and redundant. 'Сиво' (grey) or 'тъмносиво' (dark grey) would be correct and clearer.

errors.text_span: рязко пада до около 12% през 2012 г.
errors.evidence: The description states that the line for 'Ти Би Ай Банк' drops to about 12% in 2012. However, the chart shows the value in 2012 is approximately 17-18%.

errors.text_span: Линията за Токуда е бежова, с плътна линия и без маркери; тя започва около 10% през 2008 г., се покачва до около 12% през 2010 г., след което се стабилизира между 11% и 12% до 2027 г.
errors.evidence: The description for the 'Токуда' line incorrectly describes its trend. In the chart, the 'Токуда' line starts at ~11%, rises to a peak of ~14% in 2013 (not 12% in 2010), and then declines to end around 11%. The provided description almost exactly copies the trend of the 'ПроКредит Банк' line.
